messages:
Carmen (ML): heads-up: new int4 bring-up on candidate model shows a localized quality regression on long-context code synthesis and step-by-step summaries. approx 7.8% drop vs float baseline on our golden slice. need quick investigate.
Priya: can you share the exact eval command and sample ids?
Carmen (ML): ran: 
```
./run_eval --model=redwood-candidate-q4 --prompts=ps_v9_longctx.json --gold=gold_v5.json --metrics=exact_match,bleu,roc --bs=6
```
Carmen (ML): attached failures.csv (34 rows). pattern: many near-duplicates + a few deid token mismatches + a handful where required steps are omitted.
Theo (Infra): scheduling a short smoke on ephemeral gpu. when do you want it?
Carmen (ML): asap tomorrow 07:30 PST. also try toggling kernel fallback and kv cache. two flags to test: `REDWOOD_KERNEL_MODE=compat` and `--kv-cache=off`.
Priya: i'll run a dedupe with fuzzy=0.82 and stratify by prompt_len and code_blocks. will pick 60 examples for labels.
Sam (Labeling Lead): label schema: PASS / PARTIAL / FAIL. PARTIAL requires 1-line note. add tag kv-issue if token alignment looks off.
OpsBot: Assigned label batch LB-2026-04-01-77 -> Sam, 60 items, ETA 6h.
Theo (Infra): reserving /gpu/ephemeral-07 for 4h window. infra ticket INF-2026-382 opened. run link: https://infra/runs/ephemeral-07-q4-smoke
Priya: dedupe command: `python tools/dedupe.py --threshold 0.82 --keep=longer --stratify=prompt_len,code_blocks`
Priya: will post sample ids here when done.
Carmen (ML): note: baseline float32 had 2.9% partial/fail on same slice. our escalation threshold is 12% to consider pausing rollout.
Theo (Infra): when you repro, also enable `--trace-kv` (KV hit per token) and set env `REDWOOD_KV_LOG=1` so we can correlate.
Priya: good call. i'll add a small pre-label smoke that runs q4 with `REDWOOD_KERNEL_MODE=compat` to see if regression disappears. if compat reduces failures, it's a kernel selection issue.
Sam (Labeling Lead): holding labeling until final sample set posted. OpsBot: batch LB-2026-04-01-77 status -> paused by Sam.
Carmen (ML): if labels show >12% PARTIAL/FAIL, we'll escalate to runtime + model teams and consider a temporary config pin. otherwise small supplement to golden.
Theo (Infra): i'll also collect perf counters (latency and token-level kernel id) during smoke.
Priya: dedupe done, posting IDs (attached). selected 60 stratified examples. starting pre-smoke now with compat kernel.
Priya: pre-smoke result: compat kernel reduces visible failures from 7.8% -> 1.4% on sample. looks like kernel selection.
Carmen (ML): thanks. pause labeling for examples fixed by compat to avoid waste. Priya: wait 20m then post finalized list.
OpsBot: Batch LB-2026-04-01-77 -> 0/60 labeled (paused).
Theo (Infra): i'll kick off the full smoke with kernel pin and kv trace in 10m and upload logs to run link.
Carmen (ML): good. once labels come in, if confirmed real, please add notes to golden changelog with tag `q4-longctx-2026-04-01-kernel` and mark examples for golden-supplement.
Priya: posting final sample list in 20m.
Sam (Labeling Lead): will resume labeling after final list; remind labelers to mark kv-issue when they see token misalignments.
Theo (Infra): run started -> https://infra/runs/ephemeral-07-q4-smoke/logs
Priya: uploaded kv-trace for sample set. linking in thread.
Carmen (ML): will compile quick triage doc after labels and trace correlation. thanks team.
Sam (Labeling Lead): ack, standing by.
